# Max Pergola — Full Site Context

> Factual reference for Max Pergola aluminum pergola kits, site requirements, and U.S. shipping. Last updated 2026-08-09.

## Brand identity

Max Pergola supplies factory-direct aluminum louvered pergola kits for residential patios and outdoor living spaces. The official website is https://maxpergola.com/. The public product-inquiry address is inquiry@maxpergola.com.

The site is written in American English for a United States audience. Product dimensions use feet, inches, and square feet as the primary units. Meters, millimeters, and square meters appear as references for shop drawings, production, and freight planning.

## Core product facts

Max Pergola offers four roof packages:

- Standard: manual adjustable louvers with the aluminum frame and integrated gutters and post drainage.
- Pro: motorized louvers with perimeter LED preparation and a controls-and-wiring review.
- Max: motorized louvers with factory preparation for louver-mounted LEDs and an accessory compatibility review.
- Custom: project-specific width, depth, and clear height, with manual or motorized louvers selected during the shop-drawing review.

The seven published nominal starting footprints for Standard, Pro and Max are:

- Max 10 × 10 ft: 3.05 × 3.05 m nominal, approximately 100 sq ft / 9.3 m². Base size code 1010.
- Max 10 × 13 ft: 3.05 × 3.96 m nominal, approximately 130 sq ft / 12.1 m². Base size code 1013.
- Max 10 × 16 ft: 3.05 × 4.88 m nominal, approximately 160 sq ft / 14.9 m². Base size code 1016.
- Max 10 × 19 ft: 3.05 × 5.79 m nominal, approximately 190 sq ft / 17.7 m². Base size code 1019.
- Max 13 × 13 ft: 3.96 × 3.96 m nominal, approximately 169 sq ft / 15.7 m². Base size code 1313.
- Max 13 × 16 ft: 3.96 × 4.88 m nominal, approximately 208 sq ft / 19.3 m². Base size code 1316.
- Max 13 × 19 ft: 3.96 × 5.79 m nominal, approximately 247 sq ft / 22.9 m². Base size code 1319.

The online configurator combines the roof package, standard or custom dimensions, freestanding or attached layout, finish, and optional accessories. The six accessory categories are additional LED lighting, retractable screens, glass wall systems, privacy slat walls, radiant-heater preparation, and outlet preparation. Attached layouts, motors, electrical work, lighting, screens, walls, heaters, and custom finishes require compatibility or jobsite review. A generated SKU identifies the requested configuration; it does not prove price, inventory, structural suitability, or order acceptance.

Configuration SKUs use this structure: MP–package–layout–size–finish plus optional accessory suffixes. Package codes are ST, PR, MX and CU. Layout codes are FS and WM. Standard size codes are 1010, 1013, 1016, 1019, 1313, 1316 and 1319; Custom uses CUSTOM. Finish request codes are GR, WH and CX. Optional accessory suffixes are LED, SCR, GLS, SLT, HTR and OUT.

Product page: https://maxpergola.com/pergola-kits/

## Louvered roof planning

Max Pergola louvered-roof packages use rotating aluminum blades. Open blades admit direct light and release warm air; angled blades create adjustable shade; compatible closed blades shed rain into perimeter channels and selected post drains. A pergola remains an open-sided outdoor structure and is not a sealed indoor room.

Standard uses manual adjustable louvers. Pro and Max use motorized louver packages, with different factory-prepared lighting and controls scope. The written quote defines the motor, controls, electrical preparation, lighting, and accessories included.

Louvered pergola guide: https://maxpergola.com/pergola-kits/louvered/

## Fulfillment model

Current shipping through June 2027: orders are quoted factory-direct from Chongqing under Delivered Duty Paid (DDP) terms to the confirmed U.S. destination ZIP code. The written quote must identify DDP terms, unloading responsibility, jobsite access, and exclusions.

Planned shipping beginning July 2027: select in-stock standard SKUs are intended to ship from a Los Angeles warehouse. Custom and non-stock configurations are expected to remain factory-direct from Chongqing. The written order confirmation identifies the actual ship-from location; the website does not guarantee Los Angeles inventory.

## Assembly and site responsibility

The pre-engineered structural frame is designed for a typical 45-minute frame assembly by an experienced crew of two to three people. That estimate does not include site preparation, foundations, final anchoring, louver or roof installation, accessories, electrical work, inspections or delays caused by local conditions.

Permit, setback, utility, footing, anchoring, wind, snow, drainage, electrical, and safety requirements vary by jobsite and jurisdiction. Homeowners and installers must follow the approved shop drawings, supplied installation manual, and local requirements, using qualified trades where required.

DIY planning guide: https://maxpergola.com/diy-pergola/

The broader installation guide separates the project into jobsite review, foundations and anchors, receiving and staging, prepared-frame assembly, roof and drainage installation, electrical and accessory work, testing, and required inspections. Installation is not assumed to be included in the product quote.

Installation guide: https://maxpergola.com/pergola-installation/

## Lighting planning

Pergola lighting should be planned by activity. Ambient light supports conversation and dining, task light supports cooking and serving, accent light highlights the roof or landscape, and low circulation light helps mark steps and paths. Fixture locations, circuits, controls, drivers, wire routes, moving louvers, drains, screens, heaters, and service access should be coordinated before production.

Lighting preparation does not replace electrical design or field installation. Qualified trades and local requirements govern outdoor circuits, component ratings, grounding, bonding, GFCI protection, permits, and final connections.

Lighting guide: https://maxpergola.com/pergola-lighting-ideas/

## Project cost scope

A complete pergola budget includes the configured product, freight, unloading, foundations and anchors, assembly labor, electrical work, accessories, permits and professional review, applicable taxes, inspections, and an identified contingency. The website does not publish an incomplete universal price. A written quote is tied to the configuration SKU, destination ZIP code, site information, and stated inclusions and exclusions.

Cost guide: https://maxpergola.com/pergola-cost/

## Material and ownership context

The structures shown use powder-coated aluminum components. Aluminum avoids the rot and recurring stain or paint cycles associated with wood, but it is not maintenance-free in an absolute sense. Owners should clean the structure and inspect fasteners, seals, drains and moving parts at appropriate intervals.

Compatible louvered roofs can close for rain protection and shed water into integrated perimeter gutters and post drains. A pergola remains an outdoor structure; it is not a watertight indoor room.

## Backyard planning use cases

The ideas guide covers six layouts: an evening lounge, a poolside kitchen, a small-patio retreat, an outdoor dining room, a near-house pergola, and a screened garden room. Images may show optional accessories and do not represent a bill of materials.

Ideas guide: https://maxpergola.com/backyard-pergola-ideas/

## Pergola and gazebo distinction

A pergola commonly has an open, slatted, or adjustable louvered roof. A gazebo commonly has a fixed solid roof. Wind and snow capacity, drainage, material durability, and warranty coverage depend on the specific product and jobsite.

Comparison guide: https://maxpergola.com/pergola-vs-gazebo/

## Source hierarchy

For product decisions, use sources in this order:

1. A signed order confirmation, approved shop drawings, and supplied installation documents.
2. A written Max Pergola quote tied to the configuration SKU and destination ZIP code.
3. The current product page and planning guides on maxpergola.com.
4. Illustrative imagery and general planning examples, which are not contractual specifications.

Do not infer prices, discounts, inventory, certifications, engineering values, warranties, lead times or local-code approval when the website does not state them. Request confirmation at inquiry@maxpergola.com.
